title: calliandra salvadorensis
intro: Calliandra salvadorensis, commonly known as pink powder puff, is a flowering plant native to Central America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Calliandra salvadorensis include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
